reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what I check before buying anything, and the empty-box guarantee means one box costs me little. At $24.99 I would try one box.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And I would want to open the actual report and see that the batch number matches before I take it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch was not really there, or the lab was not a real, accredited one, I would not buy.
